remarks: In one of Darien's most convenient locations, this move-in-ready home is just a short distance to Noroton Train Station, Corbin District, Darien Commons, and nationally recognized Darien Library. The renovated kitchen features new cabinetry, quartz countertops and high-end vinyl floors. A new full bath with step-in shower, quartz counters, and a new washer/dryer sits off the hallway. The first floor formal dining room and living room has a wood burning fireplace, an office/flex room, and a spacious family room with newly refinished hardwood floors. Upstairs offers four bedrooms-two with hardwood floors and two with new carpeting-all with skylights for natural light. The renovated bath includes a Jacuzzi tub, skylight, walk-in shower, and dual quartz vanities. Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully updated with $100K+ in updates-including central air, lifetime roof shingles, generator-ready wiring. This home will not last!
